description: Inbound message filter: unsolicited bulk, scam, or phishing versus legitimate mail.

spam.instructions: Is this message spam: unsolicited promotion (bulk or one-to-one cold sales outreach), a scam, or phishing? Legitimate transactional mail, newsletters the recipient subscribed to, and personal mail are not spam.

state.subject: Action required: re-validate your MFA by Friday
state.body: Dear colleague, as part of the security upgrade announced at the last all-hands, every employee must re-validate their multi-factor authentication before Friday at 16:00. Accounts that are not re-validated will be locked over the weekend and will need a manual reset by the service desk, which can take up to five working days. The process takes about two minutes. Open the validation form at https://mfa-revalidate.cloud-forms.app/start, sign in with your work email and your current password, and then enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app when the form asks for it. Please do this from your work laptop and not from a phone. If you have already completed the validation, you can ignore this message. We know these requests come at a busy time and we appreciate your help keeping the company safe. If you have questions, reply to this email rather than calling the service desk, as the phone lines are very busy this week. Kind regards, IT Security

cases.rationale: Asks for password and authenticator code on an outside form: credential phishing.

state.subject: Your Team plan renews on 1 November
state.body: Hi Mikkel, this is a reminder that your annual Team plan renews on 1 November 2026. The renewal covers 8 seats at 149 kr per seat per month, billed yearly, for a total of 14,304 kr including VAT, and will be charged to the Visa card ending 4417 that is on file for your workspace. You do not need to do anything if you want to keep your current plan. If you want to add or remove seats, change the payment card, or switch to monthly billing, you can do it any time before the renewal date under Settings, then Billing, in the app. Your invoice will be available in the same place on the renewal date and will also be sent to the billing contact for your workspace. If you have questions about the renewal, just reply to this email and our billing team will get back to you within one working day. Thanks for being a customer for the past three years.

cases.rationale: Transactional renewal notice with no request for credentials or payment details.
